umf.visual.question: Bounded handler access

nodes.label: Isolated handler
nodes.detail:
No raw SQL connection, database
credentials, ambient network or broad
host mount. Only declared transaction
capabilities.

nodes.label: Controlled gateway
nodes.detail:
Freeze canonical identities. Check
every attempted read/write before
storage access. Returning state to its
old value cannot hide an attempt.

nodes.label: Consumer-owned transaction
nodes.detail:
Authorization, native invariant
checks, replay ledger and outbox are
control responsibilities. Their reads
are not handler permissions.

nodes.label: Commit or rollback
nodes.detail:
Verify outputs, constraints, frame and
postconditions. Failure aborts the
whole attempted transaction; no
partial business outcome.

panels.title: Isolated handler
panels.text: No raw SQL connection, database credentials, ambient network or broad host mount. Only declared transaction capabilities.

panels.title: Controlled gateway
panels.text: Freeze canonical identities. Check every attempted read/write before storage access. Returning state to its old value cannot hide an attempt.

panels.title: Consumer-owned transaction
panels.text: Authorization, native invariant checks, replay ledger and outbox are control responsibilities. Their reads are not handler permissions.

panels.title: Commit or rollback
panels.text: Verify outputs, constraints, frame and postconditions. Failure aborts the whole attempted transaction; no partial business outcome.
